title: Google Analytics Insights in Slack: Real-Time Marketing Monitoring Without Dashboard Fatigue
description: Monitor GA4, Google Ads, Meta Ads, Search Console, and Shopify directly in Slack. Learn how Go Insights eliminates dashboard switching with intelligent alerts for marketing and ecommerce teams.

content.text: Marketing and ecommerce teams waste hours switching between GA4, Ads Manager, and Shopify dashboards. Go Insights brings everything into Slack with intelligent alerts that surface what actually matters.

Google Analytics Insights (Go Insights) is a Slack app that connects GA4, Google Ads, Meta Ads, Google Search Console, Plausible, and Shopify directly to your Slack workspace. It monitors marketing performance 24/7 and sends intelligent alerts when metrics change — spend spikes, conversion drops, SEO shifts, or tracking failures. Adaptive baselines learn each account's normal behavior automatically, so you get meaningful alerts without manual thresholds.

items: Ad spend monitoring — catch pacing issues and overspend across Google Ads and Meta Ads with root cause analysis
Conversion and revenue alerts — detect mobile conversion drops, checkout regressions, and revenue anomalies
SEO and traffic monitoring — Google Search Console integration tracks visibility changes and position shifts
Shopify ecommerce performance — monitor store revenue, orders, and product performance directly in Slack
Weekly digests — automated summaries of wins, issues, and performance shifts for stakeholders
Agency support — route different accounts to different Slack channels for multi-client management

content.text: Marketing teams run on speed. When a campaign goes off-track, every minute of delayed reaction costs money. Go Insights removes the friction between data and action. No more manual dashboard refreshing, alerts with context so teams know where to look, adaptive sensitivity that reduces false alarms, and agency-ready multi-account management.

For ecommerce teams, every hour of undetected tracking failure or campaign underperformance means lost revenue. Go Insights provides revenue anomaly detection, tracking health monitoring, campaign delivery alerts, and a unified view of GA4, Shopify, Google Ads, and Meta Ads in one Slack channel.

Install from the Slack Marketplace in two clicks via standard OAuth. Connect your first data source, route alerts to the channel of your choice, and let adaptive baselines start learning your account's normal behavior. A free preview is available with real historical data — no credit card required.
